findings.claim: install.sh plants the presentation profile (lines 100-105) only after it has already run sync_skills.sh (line 92), so on a casual install sync_skills.sh finds no profile, takes the developer branch (drops leaf overrides, deletes the overlay) and the casual skill hiding correctness-43 requires is absent after install.
findings.evidence: Re-read install.sh 82-105 and cmd/sync/sync_skills.sh 249-301 at the pinned head. Sequence: fresh macOS install with SMINE_PRESENTATION_PROFILE=de -> install.sh:92 runs sync_skills.sh while ~/.claude/context/global/presentation-profile.md does not exist yet -> sync_skills.sh:253 skips, profile_audience stays empty -> line 263 false -> else branch 286-300 removes any leaf skillOverrides and rm -f the routine overlay -> install.sh:103 then copies the de profile (audience: casual). Result: a casual install whose ~/.claude/settings.json carries no skillOverrides 'off' entries and no ~/.config/claude-routine/skill-overrides.json, so every deployed skill stays visible/invocable in the casual user's sessions until some later sync_skills.sh run (a /profile audience change or the first successful nightly orchestrate stage). The Windows runInstall has the same order (install_windows.go:101 runSyncs before :105 installPresentationProfile) — cross-chunk, noted.
findings.fix: Move the SMINE_PRESENTATION_PROFILE copy block (install.sh 97-105) above the RUN_SYNC block so sync_skills.sh reads the installed profile.

findings.claim: On a casual install the unattended /merge-resolve run of routine_chain_sync_main executes inside the fresh routine worktree before run.sh copies the skill overlay into it, so merge-resolve (a deployed leaf set to "off" in user settings) is denied and the chain sync runs without its skill.
findings.evidence: Re-read routines/_lib/worktree.sh 56-91 and 161-178, routines/smine-nightly/run.sh 128-148, cmd/sync/sync_skills.sh 263-285, .gitignore 51. Sequence: casual profile -> sync_skills.sh sets skillOverrides.merge-resolve="off" in ~/.claude/settings.json (skills/git/merge-resolve is a deployed leaf) -> a previous nightly branch is kept unmerged (orchestrate rejected it) and main has moved with a conflicting change -> routine_worktree_create (run.sh:128) adds the worktree on the chain tip and calls routine_chain_sync_main, which runs claude -p "/merge-resolve theirs main..." with cwd $wt; the worktree has no .claude/settings.local.json (gitignored, never checked out), because run.sh copies the overlay only at 144-148, after create returned. The "off" override (documented in sync_skills.sh as hiding AND denying, incl. headless) therefore applies and the merge-resolve skill does not load; correctness-44 requires routine runs to get the overlay in their worktree. The same gap leaves routines/skill-eval/run.sh and its matrix cell worktrees without any overlay copy.
findings.fix: Copy ~/.config/claude-routine/skill-overrides.json into "$wt/.claude/settings.local.json" inside routine_worktree_create right after `git worktree add` (before routine_chain_sync_main), and drop the per-wrapper copy in smine-nightly/run.sh.

findings.claim: sync_settings.sh replaces ~/.claude/settings.json wholesale with the expanded template, which carries no skillOverrides, so any settings sync not followed by sync_skills.sh silently lifts the casual skill hiding that sync_skills.sh merged into the same file.
findings.evidence: Re-read cmd/sync/sync_settings.sh 52-72 and 169, cmd/sync/sync_skills.sh 263-269, settings/claude_code/settings.json (no skillOverrides key). sync_file diffs the expanded template against the live file and cp's it over on any difference — after sync_skills.sh added skillOverrides the files always differ, so the next sync_settings.sh run drops every "off" entry. Sequence: casual install -> user runs `bash cmd/sync/sync_settings.sh` (the fix hint fixPeekFragment the Welcome page shows when the peek fragment is missing, internal/server/welcome_darwin.go:12) -> settings.json has no skillOverrides -> all deployed skills visible and invocable in the casual user's sessions until a later sync_skills.sh. Distinct from the known additionalDirectories loss in the orchestrate flow (that flow re-runs sync_skills.sh afterwards, so skillOverrides survive it).
findings.fix: In sync_settings.sh carry the live file's .skillOverrides into the expanded template before the compare/copy (jq --slurpfile live "$dst" '.skillOverrides = $live[0].skillOverrides' when present), or run the sync_skills.sh visibility step from sync_settings.sh.

findings.claim: A squash containment proven only on a remote-tracking FROM stars the IN column (origin/main*) but is never counted as squashed: UNPICKED keeps the commits as untransferred and the detail view still prints 'no twin on any local branch', because layer 4, the squashed recount and the detail annotation iterate local candidates only.
findings.evidence: Re-read verdict.sh 417-519 and print_agent_worktrees_status.sh 152-219. Sequence: agent branch created from refs/remotes/origin/main (resolve_from -> origin/main, not a candidate), several commits, squash-merged on the remote, local main not yet pulled -> from_plus non-empty (squash patch-id differs from each commit) -> layer 4 (453-463) checks only local candidates, main does not contain the content, nothing is marked explained -> recount 469-483: hash_explained_anywhere false -> unpicked_n = n, no squashed:n in VERDICTS -> line 511 squash_contained origin/main true -> eval_in = origin/main*. The row shows UNPICKED n (documented as 'genuinely untransferred work') next to an IN that declares the branch safe; detail mode's squash_in loop (180-184) also skips the remote FROM, so each commit reads 'no twin ... verify before treating as lost' instead of the 'content contained in ... via squash' annotation correctness-117 asks for when applicable.
findings.fix: When squash_contained "$from" "$branch" holds for a non-candidate FROM, count the FROM-unplaced intersection commits as squashed (not unpicked) and include $from in print_agent_worktrees_status.sh's squash_in list.
